notes.content: We just had a long flight first from Tallin to Riga then from Riga to Istanbul then from Istanbul to Oman 4 1/2 hours last flight

Once we arrived at the airport you can see that this country is really rich straight away like I've never seen such a clean white stone marble like maybe it is marble basically the whole coverage of airport floor all around the airport is marble amazing and super super clean

So today we tried some local cuisine which was really amazing like we went to this small place we would never go ourselves. Thanks to our friend. He basically brought us there. It's really authentic. We set an hour my niece and then we were eating with our hands, it was lamb with rice really really tasteful and the price is like €5.

So our friend gave us a car which is mini Cooper. I'm really grateful for that and we decided to make it a date night. We went to a really nice restaurant looking like Arabic style like we literally arrived on the near the castle like it looks like a castle went inside. There is really authentic music and musician playing and it just looks amazing totally amazing. Never seen a place like that.
Went to grand Kabul mosque today I mean it's it's totally breathtaking. It's just surreal like really beautiful.

Carpet of wonder.• Size: Measures approximately 60.90m × 70.50m, covering about 4,343 square meters (46,750 sq ft).
• Weight: Weighs roughly 21 to 22 tons.
• Knots: Contains approximately 1.7 billion individual knots.
• Creation: Produced by the Iran Carpet Company (ICC) and hand-woven by 500 to 600 master artisans in Nishapur, Iran, taking about four years to complete

After Sultan Kabul mosque we decided to go eat some local cuisine again our friend brought us to someplace which again will never be able to pick ourselves. It's just just a small corner shop on the parking lot with amazing view and really nice lamb chops and the price is like €2.

Today we decided to go visit body shop. It's basically like a hike around 3 hours. The location is like around hour and a half from Muscat so basically it starts by us getting by boat to that hike and then we just walk and some places you need to jump over over rock some places you need to swim and in the end there is a cave with a waterfall inside.
Went to the nice 55 coffee place near the beach and of course enjoy the beach. The water is so warm and beautiful and they are not so many people. It's not crowded amazing.

Went to the bazaar place and I decided to buy myself a dish so that I can look like a person who lives there a person who respects traditions and culture of Omani people and it's it's funny but as soon as I was dressed like that after two minutes, some random girls just you know started giving me reactions like oh my God, you look nice

My friends invited me to their house where them they and their mom used to live it's absolutely astonishing. I've never seen as a person from Europe of course I've never seen anything like that. It's it's really nice.

Today we decided to visit omani national Museum which located around one hour drive from Muscat. The building is something you would not expect museum to look like like it's a sky building something you can see probably in Shanghai or Singapore.
Then we decided to visit really old city well I should go town because it's really old and small Nizwa and it's it looks like that's dust2 map from  cs2 game if you know what I mean
